L: Lan: Guys, I'm freaking out. My audition for the school band is at four.

Hoa: Fingers crossed! I'm so proud of you for even trying.
Lan: Thanks, guys. I'm kinda scared I'll forget the notes.
Minh: Don't think about that. Just play it like you do at home.
Hoa: You've got this! Text us the second you're done.
Lan: Will do. Wish me luck!

exq.why: freak out = hoảng lên; câu sau cho biết Lan lo vì buổi thử giọng.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: Take a deep ___! You've been practicing for weeks, so you'll be fine.

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: Fingers ___! I'm so proud of you for even trying.
exq.why: Fingers crossed! là cụm cố định (V3).
